title: Cancer RLTO Model
description: Cancer-adapted RLTO-inspired model for deterministic robustness–load trade-off analysis in cancer systems biology. The framework models gene-level fitness as a balance between robustness, metabolic burden, and toxicity, and extends this to tumor-level optimization under global resource constraints. It supports analytical fitness evaluation, gene-level and global optimization, intervention simulation, and diagnostic visualization.
references: Choi, H. J., Lo, T. W., Cutler, K. J., Huang, D., Will, W. R., & Wiggins, P. A. (2026). Protein overabundance is driven by growth robustness. Science Advances, 12(12), eadz9623. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adz9623
notes: This implementation is a principled engineering adaptation of robustness–load trade-off (RLTO) concepts for cancer systems biology. It is not a direct reproduction of the full mathematical formalism of the referenced publication.
